title: 第十一章
slug: 娇软妹宝随军后禁欲军官沦陷了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

她说话时，浴巾有些松了。

看着那露出大片春光，傅谨严眼睛狠狠一闭，紧接着，就头也不回离开了。

“有病!”

苏清荔骂道。

把身体重新擦干净，苏清荔躺在床上。

心里期盼笔试的那天快点到来。

不然她怕自己对傅谨严起了杀心。

而另一边，傅谨严从院子里出来后，就径直去了部队的洗澡堂。

足足冲了半小时的冷水澡，可心里那抹燥意却依旧没有下去。

见此，他暗骂一声。

出来后，恰巧碰到也来洗澡的副官。

“怎么了？”副官见他一脑门官司的模样，不由得问：“谁惹你了？”

傅谨严没正面回答。

而是说，“你告诉小周，让他离苏清荔远点。”

副官坏笑，“不想让他当你妹夫？成啊，你看我怎么样？”

傅谨严面无表情把手里的毛巾扔他脸上。

“......”副官深吸一口气，劝自己，殴打上级要记大过，他还年轻，好好的前途可不能到此为止。

到了第二天，副官找到小周。

尽管他语气足够委婉，但小周却还是表情失落。

“我知道了。”

副官见此，拍拍他的肩。

“傅营也是为了你好。”

这段时间，他跟在傅营身边，或多或少也知道傅谨严在顾及什么。

虽然他看着苏清荔，觉得对方压根不像传言那样，但人都会伪装。

现在阻止小周，总比以后他知道真相更好一些。

而另一边，杨文花自从那天看见小周跟苏清荔走到一起，心中就烦躁无比。

这天，她看着整日只知道待在家里缝缝补补的女儿，语气有些恨铁不成钢，“你说你，整天憋在家里，怎么能跟小周培养感情？”

杨春喜正给小侄子做虎头鞋，闻言表情有些委屈，“妈。我也找过小周，可他跟我说不两句就说要回去忙，我总不能耽误他工作吧？”

杨文花看着她，觉得问题也不在她身上。

“都怪苏清荔，要不是她整天端着一副狐媚子模样，在老爷们面前晃荡，小周哪能看不到你？”

杨春喜想了想，“苏清荔可是傅营妹妹，凭着他哥，想找什么样的没有，不能看上小周吧？”

杨文花点了点杨春喜的头，“她哥再出息，跟她有啥关系？说到底不还是乡下来的泥腿子？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The towel came loose as she spoke.

Looking at the large spring light, Fu Jinyan closed his eyes tightly, and then left without looking back.

"Sick!"

Su Qingli cursed.

After wiping her body clean again, Su Qingli lay on the bed.

I was looking forward to the day of the written test coming soon.

Otherwise, she was afraid that she would have murderous intentions towards Fu Jinyan.

On the other side, after Fu Jingyan came out of the yard, he went straight to the army bathhouse.

I took a cold shower for half an hour, but the dryness in my heart still didn't go away.

Seeing this, he cursed secretly.

After coming out, I happened to meet the adjutant who also came to take a bath.

"What's wrong?" Seeing the lawsuit on his forehead, the adjutant couldn't help but ask, "Who provoked you?"

Fu Jingyan did not answer directly.

Instead, he said, "Tell Xiao Zhou to stay away from Su Qingli."

The adjutant smiled evilly, "You don't want him to be your brother-in-law? Sure, what do you think of me?"

Fu Jinyan expressionlessly threw the towel in his face.

"..." The adjutant took a deep breath and advised himself that beating his superior would be a major demerit. He was still young and his good future could not end here.

The next day, the adjutant found Xiao Zhou.

Although his tone was tactful enough, Xiao Zhou still looked disappointed.

"I understand."

Seeing this, the adjutant patted him on the shoulder.

"Fu Ying is also doing this for your own good."

During this period, he followed Fu Ying and more or less knew what Fu Jinyan was taking care of.

Although he looked at Su Qingli and felt that the other party was not at all like the rumors, people could pretend.

It is better to stop Xiao Zhou now than to let him know the truth later.

On the other side, Yang Wenhua has been extremely irritable since she saw Xiao Zhou and Su Qingli coming together that day.

On this day, she looked at her daughter, who just stayed at home sewing and mending all day, and said in a somewhat resentful tone, "How can you cultivate a relationship with Xiao Zhou when you stay at home all day?"

Yang Chunxi was making tiger-head shoes for her little nephew, and she looked a little aggrieved when she heard this, "Mom. I also asked Xiao Zhou, but he said he would go back to work without saying a few words to me. I can't delay his work, right?"

Yang Wenhua looked at her and felt that the problem was not hers.

"It's all Su Qingli's fault. If she hadn't been wandering around in front of the old men like a fox all day long, how could Xiao Zhou not see you?"

Yang Chunxi thought for a while, "Su Qingli is Fu Ying's sister. With his brother, what kind of person are you looking for? You can't fall in love with Xiao Zhou, right?"

Yang Wenhua nodded Yang Chunxi's head, "What does her brother's future career have to do with her? After all, isn't he still a mud-legged kid from the countryside?"
